parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type AGONIST. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type equals AGONIST. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id as target_chembl_id, and pref_name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
